claim: The 2026 Michelin Guide KL & Penang awards 9 stars across Malaysia; 7 restaurants are in KL, comprising one 2-star and six 1-star.
quote: At a Glance: All the Restaurants in the MICHELIN Guide Kuala Lumpur & Penang 2026

claim: Akar and Terra Dining earned their first Michelin stars in the 2026 edition of the guide.
quote: Two new progressive Malaysian restaurants in KL get Michelin stars in Michelin Guide KL & Penang 2026

claim: Dewakan is Malaysia's only two-star restaurant and also holds Malaysia's first Michelin Green Star for sustainable practices.
quote: Dewakan – Kuala Lumpur: Malaysia's First Two Michelin Star + Green Star Restaurant

claim: Dewakan's tasting menu is priced at RM870 nett per person; wine pairings at RM353 (5-glass) or RM636 (7-glass); non-alcoholic pairing RM266; dinner Mon–Sat from 6 pm.
quote: Dewakan Tasting Menu: RM870 nett per person … Credit card required to guarantee bookings

claim: Beta KL offers Tour of Malaysia (RM630++) and Flora of Malaysia (RM550++) tasting menus; Chef Raymond Tham combines French technique with Malaysian soul.
quote: Beta KL – Kuala Lumpur's Michelin-Starred Culinary Journey Through Malaysia

claim: Chim by Chef Noom's 9-course menu includes a 200-year-old tom yum variant and giant Hyogo oyster with pickled chilli granita.
quote: Terrific Michelin-starred Thai fine-dining fare at Chim By Chef Noom

claim: Chim by Chef Noom is located at L2-03, TSLAW Tower, 39 Jalan Kamuning, Imbi, and offers seasonal multicourse tasting menus from RM600++ per person.
quote: 1 Michelin Star … L2-03, TSLAW Tower, 39, Jalan Kamuning, Imbi, 55100 Kuala Lumpur

claim: DC restaurant introduced à la carte in 2025 alongside its tasting menu, enabling larger cuts; the Cellar omakase is an 8-seater counter hosted by Darren Chin himself.
quote: Review: Michelin-Starred DC Restaurant Enters its Next Phase

claim: Molina won the MICHELIN Guide Kuala Lumpur & Penang 2025 Opening of the Year award, earning its star within five months of opening.
quote: Molina Kuala Lumpur Shines Bright as 2025's Opening of the Year Award Winner

claim: Molina is located on Level 51 of the FACE STYLE Hotel, 1020 Jalan Sultan Ismail; open Tue–Sat from 6 pm with Saturday lunch also available; menus from 5 to 9 courses.
quote: 1020 Jalan Sultan Ismail, Level 51, 50250 Kuala Lumpur … Tuesday - Saturday from 6pm

claim: Akar's nine-course dinner menu changes every six months; notable dishes include marble goby with fisherman's broth, mud crab claypot rice, and ketupat with silver catfish.
quote: Akar: Modern Malaysian Restaurant With A Solid 1 Michelin Star

claim: Akar earned its first Michelin Star for refashioning European recipes with Japanese, French and Malaysian influences, using techniques like cooking in melted beeswax.
quote: Akar – Kuala Lumpur - a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant

claim: Terra Dining's French-leaning 11-course menu uses Malaysian produce: lobster bisque uses smoky Tahal oil echoing asam laksa; beurre blanc incorporates coconut milk masak lemak.
quote: Terra Dining serves an immersive symphony of Malaysian flavours, led by chef-owner Chong Yu Cheng

claim: Terra Dining is located at 91G Jalan Aminuddin Baki, TTDI; reservations via inline.app or +6011-70727777; tea pairings available.
quote: The cuisine at Terra is a lifelong work in progress

claim: Beta KL is at Ground Floor, Cormar Suites, 10 Jalan Perak (near KLCC); open Tue–Sun 6–11 pm; RM300/pp credit card hold required.
quote: reservation … RM 300 per diner to secure reservations

claim: DC by Darren Chin is at 44 Persiaran Zaaba, TTDI; open Wed–Sun dinner, Fri–Sat lunch; multi-floor venue with Moonbar, tasting rooms, and Cellar omakase.
quote: No. 44 Persiaran Zaaba, Taman Tun Dr Ismail, 60000 Kuala Lumpur

claim: Akar is at 109 Jalan Aminuddin Baki, TTDI; Mekar dinner menu RM588++, lunch RM288++; 48-hour cancellation policy with RM334 nett/pp charge.
quote: 109, Jalan Aminuddin Baki, Taman Tun Dr Ismail, 60000 Kuala Lumpur
